[Intro]
[Cm]

[Verse 1]
[Cm]The sickness of this world is
destroying all the dreams
The fools are kings,
tearing apart the soul
The race for complication
communicate reaction
The lack of heart of men,
I grow distant from the core

[Chorus]
[Eb][Dm]Borrow
[F]this body for [Gm]a
[Eb][Dm]lifetime,
earthly material
[Dm]My [Eb]soul
[F]unraveled out [Gm]of
[Eb][Dm]mental
The shell returns to dust

[Bridge]
[Cm]

[Verse 2]
[Cm]I focus on the present
concentrate on what I find
Accelerate the vision
high beyond the curse of time
Bring light to my attention,
the walls of vacuum fall
This force increases
and tells me where to go

[Chorus]
[Eb][Dm]Follow,
[F]I enter my [Gm]di-
[Eb][Dm]mensions,
awakened heart of life
[Eb][Dm]Enforce
[F]my senses, I'm [Gm]under-
[Eb][Dm]standing I
find the will to live straight

[Solo]
[Cm]

[Pre-Verse]
[Cmmaj7]

[Verse 3]
[Cmmaj7]I feel the change I see the
[Ebaug]vicious circle
[Cmmaj7]Finally turned into a
[Ebaug]virtuous one
[Cmmaj7]Having the whole world
[Ebaug]in my hands, filled
[Cmmaj7]Timelessness
[Ebaug]
[Cmmaj7]Out of the frame I feel so
[Ebaug]vast I'm all around myself
[Cmmaj7]Imaginative
[Ebaug]interaction
[Cmmaj7]But I keep struggling in-
[Ebaug]side to hold this always
[Cmmaj7]Forever there
[Ebaug]
[G/D]

[Interlude]
[Cm]
[Bdim7/C]
[Cm]
[Bdim7/C]
[Cm]
[Bdim7/C]
[Cm]
[Bdim7/C]

[Verse 4]
[Cm]Is it the fear to fall in space
[Bdim7/C]that keeps us from understanding
[Cm]The only way to find the
[Bdim7/C]power is to look inside
Increase your fall on purpose
and let this river flow
Now you hold this secret appeared
out of the vacuum of space

[Verse 5]
[Cm]Remain in what you are,
[Bdim7/C]the center of your li fe
[Cm]You made it to this point
[Bdim7/C]no one can tell you how
You crawled and bled all the way
but you were the only one That
was tearing your soul apart,
you finally find yourself

[Outro]
[Cm]
title: Vacuity
tuning: C G C F A D
